openings.claim: Linking confusion-count sensitivity to the sampling log may improve bounded review through adaptive selection, rather than merely combining counting and traceability.
openings.delta: Change the interface: A sends record-level effects on overall gain and slice losses to B; B records selection rationale and returns adjudicated labels to A. Each return recomputes possible decision bounds and the next selection. Parent counting and logging functions remain intact.
openings.prediction: Against the nearest rival, additive counting plus auditability, intact coupling should narrow acceptance-relevant bounds more per successful adjudication than a disconnected, initially frozen selection order. It may instead expose unresolved status; no advance or physical synergy is presumed.
openings.probe: Use the two matched copies for intact versus link-broken runs. Break only the reciprocal interface: retain both parents, initial counts, log fields and supplied records; freeze the disconnected selection order before returns. Use identical initial selection criteria and preselected four withheld rows. Log attempted access without charging allowance; charge each successful adjudication, maximum sixteen per copy. Select among accessible flagged rows whose supplied label possibilities can change overall or slice acceptance bounds. Freeze reports before opening the full-label key. Baseline is provisional counts without inspection; A alone counts against labels returned in the frozen logs; B alone supplies that inspection ledger. Obtain these three reference views by replay, without extra accesses; they are diagnostic references, not independent trials. Compare baseline, A alone, B alone, intact A×B and broken-link views for supported decision, affected slices, bound reduction, adjudication accounting and key agreement. Record setup, reconciliation and maintenance minutes within seventy total analyst minutes.
assumptions: Supplied records permit bounds over existing label possibilities; adjudication may still leave critical bounds crossing the unchanged thresholds.
Defeat: equal bound reduction, worse key agreement, or coupling overhead exhausting seventy minutes. Sixteen accesses alone cannot establish informativeness.
Replay cannot isolate all causal effects; one matched comparison supports only this synthetic task.

assessment: Probe only. Apply gain ≥4 and every slice loss ≤2 exactly; otherwise reject when supported or report unresolved. Reproduce reports from supplied records and logs; do not infer deployment readiness.
